name: Kindred Judgment
oracle_text: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.
blocked_sentences: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.

needs.what: an effect selector that excludes objects of the creature type the source chose: `not_subtypes: [{"chosen_type_of": "self"}]`, resolved against the spell's `chosen_type` the way `subtypes` already is, so `destroy` over `{zone: battlefield, controller: any, count: all, types: [Creature], not_subtypes: [{chosen_type_of: self}]}` destroys every creature not of the chosen type at once (a changeling, being every type, survives)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_type` on a spell stores `chosen_type` on the spell and `selectors.matches` substitutes `{"chosen_type_of": "self"}` only inside `subtypes` (via `characteristics.resolve_chosen_subtypes`); `not_subtypes` is compared as a literal list, so the dict entry never matches any subtype and the selector would destroy every creature, chosen type included. The selector language has no general negation, and a `for_each` + `if` + `exists` workaround would destroy the creatures one at a time instead of simultaneously, which is not the printed "destroy all"
